roles.name: admin
roles.description: System administrator - operate the deployment: users, roles and all system settings

roles.name: contributor
roles.description: Organization member - manage own settings and storage objects, use AI

roles.name: viewer
roles.description: Read-only organization member - view content and manage own settings

roles.name: org_admin
roles.description: Organization administrator - everything a contributor can do, plus manage the organization members and invites

permissions.name: system_settings:read
permissions.description: Read system settings

permissions.name: system_settings:write
permissions.description: Modify system settings

permissions.name: user_settings:read
permissions.description: Read own user settings

permissions.name: user_settings:write
permissions.description: Modify own user settings

permissions.name: users:read
permissions.description: View user list and details

permissions.name: users:write
permissions.description: Modify user accounts

permissions.name: rbac:manage
permissions.description: Manage roles and permissions

permissions.name: allowlist:read
permissions.description: View allowlisted emails

permissions.name: allowlist:write
permissions.description: Manage allowlisted emails

permissions.name: storage:read
permissions.description: Read object metadata, get download URLs

permissions.name: storage:write
permissions.description: Upload, update metadata

permissions.name: storage:delete_any
permissions.description: Admin: delete any object

permissions.name: jobs:read
permissions.description: View queued, running and completed jobs

permissions.name: jobs:write
permissions.description: Enqueue, retry and cancel jobs

permissions.name: nodes:read
permissions.description: View worker nodes and their health

permissions.name: nodes:write
permissions.description: Register, drain and remove worker nodes

permissions.name: db_backup:read
permissions.description: View backup schedule, history and status

permissions.name: db_backup:write
permissions.description: Configure the backup schedule and run a backup

permissions.name: db_backup:restore
permissions.description: Restore the database from a backup

permissions.name: broadcasts:read
permissions.description: View notification broadcasts and their delivery history

permissions.name: broadcasts:write
permissions.description: Compose, schedule, cancel and send notification broadcasts

permissions.name: push:read
permissions.description: View Web Push (VAPID) configuration

permissions.name: push:write
permissions.description: Generate, rotate, enable/disable and remove Web Push VAPID keys

permissions.name: storage_config:read
permissions.description: View the object-storage configuration and the masked status of its stored secret key

permissions.name: storage_config:write
permissions.description: Change the object-storage provider, bucket, endpoint and credential, test a configuration, and provision a bucket

permissions.name: ai_config:read
permissions.description: View the deployment-wide AI platform policy

permissions.name: ai_config:write
permissions.description: Change whether AI is enabled, the key policy, per-provider configuration and the deployment-wide defaults

permissions.name: ai:use
permissions.description: Call AI models using a saved key

permissions.name: org_ai_config:read
permissions.description: View this organization's AI keys, usage and AI policy overrides

permissions.name: org_ai_config:write
permissions.description: Set or remove this organization's AI provider keys and tighten its AI policy

permissions.name: telemetry:read
permissions.description: View telemetry settings and status

permissions.name: telemetry:write
permissions.description: Change telemetry settings

permissions.name: telemetry:query
permissions.description: Run SQL, export and use the AI assistant against telemetry

permissions.name: org_members:read
permissions.description: View the members of the organization and their organization roles

permissions.name: org_members:write
permissions.description: Change organization members: their organization role, suspend or remove them

permissions.name: org_invites:read
permissions.description: View pending and past invitations to the organization

permissions.name: org_invites:write
permissions.description: Invite people to the organization and revoke invitations

permissions.name: organizations:read
permissions.description: List the deployment's organizations and their member counts

permissions.name: organizations:write
permissions.description: Create organizations (with a first administrator invitation) and rename them

permissions.name: groups:read
permissions.description: View the groups you belong to, answer your group invitations and leave a group

permissions.name: groups:write
permissions.description: Create groups and manage the members and invitations of groups you administer

permissions.name: groups:admin
permissions.description: View and administer every group of the organization, including groups you do not belong to

permissions.name: sharing:read
permissions.description: View what is shared with you and who a record you can share is shared with, and remove your own access

permissions.name: sharing:write
permissions.description: Share records you are allowed to share with people and groups of the organization, and change or revoke those shares

permissions.name: sharing:admin
permissions.description: Manage the shares of every record of the organization, including records you do not own

permissions.name: org_settings:read
permissions.description: Read the active organization's settings overrides

permissions.name: org_settings:write
permissions.description: Modify the active organization's settings overrides

permissions.name: org_broadcasts:read
permissions.description: View the active organization's notification broadcasts

permissions.name: org_broadcasts:write
permissions.description: Compose, schedule, cancel and send notification broadcasts to the active organization

permissions.name: system:factory_reset
permissions.description: Factory reset: delete every other user and all application data, keeping configuration and backups

permissions.name: orgs:offboard
permissions.description: Offboard an organization: delete it with all its data, members and invitations

permissions.name: transcripts:read
permissions.description: Read own and shared transcripts (list, get, segments, versions, exporters)

permissions.name: transcripts:write
permissions.description: Create, correct, share and delete own transcripts; edit a transcript shared with the editor role

permissions.name: notes:read
permissions.description: Read own notes (list, get, versions, the generation stream)

permissions.name: notes:write
permissions.description: Create, regenerate, edit and delete own notes; preview a note template

permissions.name: note_templates:read
permissions.description: Read the built-in and own note templates

permissions.name: note_templates:write
permissions.description: Create, edit and delete own custom note templates

permissions.name: graph:read
permissions.description: Read own connected-knowledge graph: entities, relations, facts, proposals and the effective ontology

permissions.name: graph:write
permissions.description: Commit proposals and edit, merge and forget entities in own graph; manage attribute definitions
